mapper.select: /* selectCommonCoCoIssueHistList */ SELECT TO_CHAR(MN.ADD_DATE, 'YYYY/MM/DD') AS ADD_DATE, (SELECT TEXT1 FROM ICOMCOD1 WHERE TYPE = 'PMNGTYPE' AND CODE = MN.TYPE) AS TYPE_NAME, (SELECT TEXT1 FROM ICOMCOD1 WHERE TYPE = 'PMNGSTTS' AND CODE = MN.STATUS) AS STATUS_TEXT, MN.AGENT_REMARK, MN.KEP_REMARK, MN.ATOA_REMARK, (SELECT USER_NAME_LOC FROM ICOMLUSR WHERE USER_ID = MN.ADD_USER_ID) AS ADD_USER, (SELECT USER_NAME_LOC FROM ICOMLUSR WHERE USER_ID = MN.CONFIRM_USER_ID) AS CONFIRM_USER, TO_CHAR(MN.CONFIRM_DATE, 'YYYY/MM/DD') AS CONFIRM_DATE, MN.NOTICE_DATE FROM KEP_PO_MNG MN WHERE MN.BUYER = #{st_buyer} AND MN.PO_NO = #{st_po_no} AND MN.PO_SEQ IN (#{st_po_seq}, '000000') ORDER BY MN.ADD_DATE DESC
